label: judgment
explanation: Two factors disqualify this posting. First, the title is 'Software Engineering Intern' — a general SWE role covering full stack, backend, infrastructure, and cloud — which does not align with Priya's target roles of 'AI Engineer / ML Engineer' (primary) or 'Data Engineer' (secondary). Second, the location is London, United Kingdom, and Priya needs sponsorship (profile.needs_sponsorship: true); the posting description makes no mention of visa or work-authorization sponsorship support for the UK location, making it an unreliable match on that dimension. Although the description's requirement for a general-purpose language like Python matches skills.languages and the Databricks platform context matches skills.data_bi, these skill overlaps are insufficient to overcome the title and location mismatches.
